journey.title: Portable content restore
journey.purpose: Demonstrate the accepted portable content restore outcome with exact identities, authority and adverse branches.

steps.intent: Choose readable or machine archive of permitted records with missing-dependency warnings.
Inspect credentials/private-context exclusions and explicit archive schema/version.
Dry-run namespace/mapping, same-title conflict and partial restore without unrelated overwrite.
Verify representative restored identity relationships and archive/deletion recovery limits.
